conventions.convention: Use rational coefficients and AC. T=(C×)^r acts algebraically on separated finite-type complex varieties with a finite invariant affine open cover; K=(S¹)^r uses the product right Milnor model.
Associated character lines use (e,z)·t=(e·t,χ(t)⁻¹z). Their first Chern classes are uχ=Σ nᵢuᵢ; the multiplicative set contains products of nontrivial character classes.

The equivariant dualizing object restricts to the ordinary dualizing object, without a quotient-stack shift. A smooth pure complex d-dimensional fundamental class has homological degree 2d; degree-q cohomology lowers homological degree by q.

Localize the total graded Borel–Moore module before taking degree pieces. The notation S_T⁻¹H_j means that localized degree piece; β/s has homological degree deg(β)+deg(s), with denominator degree measured cohomologically.
Gysin maps and Euler classes use complex orientation, with positive fiber Thom generator, i![X]_T=[F]_T and rank-zero Euler class 1.
The intrinsic localized trace is p_F* composed with the inverse of fixed-inclusion pushforward and requires a proper fixed locus. It is not an ordinary pushforward along a nonproper map.

load_bearing.statement: For an algebraic product-torus action on a separated finite-type complex variety with a finite invariant affine open cover, assuming AC and rational coefficients, define normalized equivariant Borel–Moore homology, its character-class cap action, and the degree pieces of its localized total graded module.

Let T=(C×)^r act algebraically on a separated finite-type complex variety X admitting a finite invariant affine open cover. For F=X^T and its closed inclusion i, proper pushforward i_* is an isomorphism on character-localized equivariant Borel–Moore homology in every homological degree. No compactness of X, normality hypothesis, or compact-orbit-type nilpotence hypothesis is required.

For an algebraic product-torus action on smooth separated finite-type X with a finite invariant affine open cover, F=X^T is smooth with invariant tangent spaces and only nontrivial normal weights. The complex-oriented refined Gysin map satisfies i!i_*β=e_T(ν_F)∩β, componentwise with degree shift minus twice the complex codimension. If F is proper, its normal Euler class is a unit after character localization; rank-zero normal bundles have Euler class 1.

For the stated torus action and invariant affine chart U, a regular eigenfunction satisfying f(t·x)=χ(t)f(x), with χ nontrivial and D(f) nonempty, makes uχ act by zero on equivariant Borel–Moore homology of D(f) and every further invariant open V contained in D(f). Their character-localized groups vanish in all degrees.

For smooth separated finite-type X with an algebraic product-torus action, a finite invariant affine open cover and proper fixed locus F, define p_*^loc=p_F*∘(i_*)⁻¹ on localized Borel–Moore degree pieces. Allowed insertions are equivariant cohomology classes capped with the complex-oriented fundamental class.

For smooth separated finite-type X of pure complex dimension d with an algebraic product-torus action, a finite invariant affine open cover and proper fixed locus decomposed into connected components F_a, the intrinsic localized pushforward of α∩[X]_T, for homogeneous α of degree q, equals Σ_a p_a*((i_a*α/e_T(ν_a))∩[F_a]_T) in localized Borel–Moore degree 2d−q. It agrees with genuine pushforward when X is proper, is independent of the cover, and is compatible with proper equivariant maps between such varieties.
